title: OnchainTransfer v1
description: One ERC-20 (or native ETH) transfer on Ethereum. Streaming: canonical.onchain_transfers.v1 produced by streaming/normalizer [R2] from eth_rpc logs. Batch: silver.onchain_transfers built by [R4] from AWS public blockchain token_transfers uses the SAME column names. Consumers: detector [R3] (risky inflow), graph [R4].

log_index.description: Log index inside the block; -1 for native ETH value transfers.

token_address.description: Lowercase contract address; '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' for native ETH.

amount_raw.description: Integer amount before decimals, as decimal string (can exceed 2^64).

amount.description: amount_raw / 10^decimals. Null if token unknown in token_registry.

amount_usd.description: As-of USD value using minute price; null if unavailable.

status.description: pending = seen, fewer than N confirmations; confirmed = ≥ N confirmations; retracted = removed by a reorg (log.removed=true).
